lead: A new `Core` row trips frozen assertions in modules it does not touch.
body: A `CoreTy::Text(Qual::Launder)` parameter fails `nvs_stdlib::html`'s `every_launderer_for_an_auto_escaping_sink_answers_a_carrier`, which asserts that roster whole across every class, and an unclassified `CoreTy::Str` in a `CoreOption` fails `every_member_parameter_carries_a_qualifier_classification`, because an option is a parameter. Run `bun nv verify -p nvs-stdlib` after writing a row and before the full gate.
